{{Quote|Consider these... a gift.|Count Dooku upon bestowing the lightsabers to Asajj Ventress|<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 7">{{CW|7}}</ref>}}
These '''lightsabers''' were a pair of [[Curved-hilt lightsaber/Legends|curved-hilt lightsabers]] wielded by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] that once belonged to [[Komari Vosa]].<ref name="Official Site Forums">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=146095&start=361|thread=Clone Wars micro-series continuity discussion|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|nobackup=1}}</ref><ref name="StarWars.com Message Boards">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=146095&start=60#5301701|thread=Clone Wars micro-series continuity discussion|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2003-11-17|time=5:20 PM}}</ref><ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]'' {{C|Asajj Ventress}} {{C|p.184}}</ref> The lightsabers could be joined together to make a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|saberstaff]].

==Specifications==
[[File:Ventress-SWE.png|thumb|left|200px|Ventress wielding the lightsabers with deadly efficiency.]]
The [[Interlocking hilt|paired lightsabers]] used by [[Komari Vosa]] and [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] emitted a red blade when activated. The [[activation stud]] on these lightsabers was concealed.<ref name="New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> As paired [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], the two weapons could be joined together at the [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]] with [[Fibercord/Legends|fibercord]] to function as a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|saberstaff]], but due to the [[Curved-hilt lightsaber/Legends|curved form of the handle]], it was somewhat more difficult to wield, especially with the precision demanded by [[Form II/Legends|Makashi]].

==Users==
===Komari Vosa===
Komari Vosa only began using her curved-hilt lightsabers after turning to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], during her tenure with the [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]] cult. She [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|wielded]] them until her [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] at the hands of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and her former master [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].<ref name="Bounty Hunter" />

===Asajj Ventress===
<div style="float:left">[[File:Cloak_of_Darkness.png|thumb|left|220px|Asajj Ventress using her lightsabers to fight Luminara Unduli and Ahsoka Tano]]</div>
Asajj Ventress began using these lightsabers during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], after receiving them from [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku.<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 7" /> They were used against [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]] in a mock ambush on [[Ruul (moon)|Ruul]], where [[K'Kruhk]] almost died by her blade. When Ventress faced [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], her use of Vosa's lightsabers almost took his life. After killing [[Tauht]] on [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]], Ventress used these lightsabers against [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]].

[[Luminara's lightsaber/Legends|Luminara Unduli's lightsaber]] and [[Ahsoka Tano's lightsabers/Legends|Ahsoka Tano's lightsaber]] crossed with those of Ventress in her attempt to rescue [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] when he was being held on the [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']]. [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] would once again face Ventress, this time with [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] on [[Alzoc III/Legends|Alzoc III]]. During the [[Battle of Sullust/Legends|Battle of Sullust]], she crossed blades with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], briefly losing one of her lightsabers. After a failed attempt on her life by Dooku, Ventress attempted to kill her former master, first in conjunction with [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress's]] [[Savage Opress's lightsaber/Legends|lightstaff]], and then without the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak's]] help.

During the [[Skirmish above Raydonia/Legends|fight]] above [[Raydonia/Legends|Raydonia]], Kenobi briefly borrowed one of Ventress' lightsabers in order to regain his own which had been taken by [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].

===Barriss Offee===
[[File:AhsokavsBarriss-TCAJ.png|thumb|left|220px|Barriss Offee using the lightsabers to duel Ahsoka Tano.]]
{{Quote|Funny, those belong to Ventress. You should've gotten rid of them!"<br />"I think they suit me.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] shortly before [[Duel at the Jedi Temple/Legends|their duel]]|<ref name="The Wrong Jedi">{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}</ref>}}
After the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|Bombing of the Jedi Temple Hangar]], Ventress used her curved lightsabers to engage [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] as she hid from Republic authorities for being framed of the bombings at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Temple]]. Ventress later helped Tano to prove her innocence and escorted her to the [[Abandoned munitions warehouse/Legends|Level 1315 warehouse]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]]. After parting ways with Tano, Ventress was ambushed by [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], who had turned to the dark side of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Offee took Ventress's lightsabers along with her mask after knocking her out, then confronted Tano in a duel at the warehouse. Offee then used these lightsabers to duel Skywalker at the Jedi Temple after he had found out that she was the true mastermind behind the attack.
